“What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”
says the LORD. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls
or of lambs
or of male goats.
What use to me is the number of the offerings which you give me? says the Lord; your burned offerings of sheep
and the best parts of fat cattle
are a weariness to me; I take no pleasure in the blood of oxen
or of lambs
or of he-goats.
